quadrants.title: External forces
quadrants.description: This quadrant tracks the 'Outside-In' pressures that define your constraints. It includes evolving compliance mandates (privacy, sustainability, and sovereignty), shifts in the global talent market, and vendor landscape volatility.

quadrants.title: Operating model
quadrants.description: Practices and tools for managing and maintaining IT infrastructure, ensuring reliability, performance, and security of systems and applications.

quadrants.title: Technology & Tools
quadrants.description: tracks the specific technical tools, architectures, and platforms that provide new capabilities to the business.

quadrants.title: Strategy and Architecture
quadrants.description: Strategies and Architecture trends impacting how the IT Operating model is designed and operated.

rings.title: Mature
rings.description: Mature technologies that are widely adopted and have proven their value in various contexts. These technologies are stable, well-supported, and have a strong track record of success.

rings.title: Adopt
rings.description: Technologies that are gaining traction and are recommended for adoption in new projects.

rings.title: Assess
rings.description: Technologies that are being evaluated for potential future adoption.

rings.title: Monitor
rings.description: Technologies that are being monitored for potential future assessment.
